_doc: One entry per guild page (/fable/, /nightshift/): name and server shown on the site, faction (alliance or horde: PvP rank badges in ranks/ or ranks/horde/), tagline under the name on the home page. settings: overrides of config/site.json settings (min_weeks, min_role_weeks...); rank: overrides of config/tiers.json rank (weeks_per_rank: one PvP rank per that many reset weeks instead of per tier); home: overrides of config/site.json home for this guild (e.g. pinned_top_n, pinned_columns: the Guild Legends top in two columns). partial: crawl not finished (meta.partial, not shown on the site). wip: text of the Work in progress banner, for a guild whose page is not final yet (crawl or reroll mapping in progress). expansions: the expansions a guild has raided so far (the first ones, in order; all of them when absent): the other expansions, their tiers and the classes they bring (Death Knight, Monk) leave the filters. Site texts may use {guild}, replaced by the name when the data loads.

fable.name: Fable
fable.tagline: Seven years of raiding, from Molten Core to Siege of Orgrimmar. Every pull, every wipe, every questionable decision.

nightshift.name: NightShift
nightshift.tagline: Every pull, every wipe, every questionable decision. For the Horde.
nightshift.wip: NightShift's logs are still being crawled and alts are not matched to their mains yet: names and numbers will move.
